Now, he has been invited back to the Congo to serve as a trade emissary of Parliament, unaware that he is a pawn in a deadly convergence of greed and revenge, masterminded by the Belgian, Captain Leon Rom (Oscar® winner Christoph Waltz). programme.title: Peppa Pig S1 Ep.105: Hide and Seek
programme.desc: Peppa and George decide to play a game of hide and seek.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: Un Si Grand Soleil
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Lévy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. programme.title: Temps Présent

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Influenceurs, Quand Le Savoir Devient Viral
programme.desc: What do a radiologist, a science communicator, a permaculturist, a veterinarian and a physiotherapist have in common? They have all become content creators on social networks. Neither artists nor singers, these professionals become public figures despite themselves. When knowledge meets virality: investigation.

programme.title: Faites Entrer La Nature
programme.desc: Lawyer and pioneer of the rights of nature, Marine Calmet is preparing an unprecedented legal action against the French state following the culling of more than 800 sharks on Réunion Island. By her side is oceanographer François Sarano. At the same time, the activist is fighting to make the oceans the new legal subjects of the 21st century.

programme.title: Échappées Belles

programme.title: Habitants Du Nord Ep.6: Those who pass this way

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
